name: keep-going
description: When Claude stops to offer an in-scope, reversible next step it could just take ("Want me to continue?"), sends it back to finish the work. Never for decisions, risky or outward actions, or finished work. /keep-going lists nudges, /keep-going off|on.

enabled.title: Send Claude back to work
enabled.description: When Claude ends a turn by offering to do in-scope, reversible work it could just do, block the stop and tell it to finish.

maxNudges.title: Most nudges per request
maxNudges.description: How many times keep-going may send Claude back to work for one request of yours.
